item.title: Heavy markup
item.description:
Council & residents met on Monday to discuss the harbour plan — a proposal that has divided opinion.

  • Cost: £4m
  • Timeline: three years

Supporters argue the redevelopment will bring jobs, while opponents worry about traffic, noise and the loss of the old fish market that has traded on the quay for generations. A second public meeting is scheduled for next month, and the council has promised to publish every written submission before the vote takes place in the chamber.
